CUFFT_DEVICE_VERSION.doc: Compile-time cuFFT experimental device API version code. This identifies the headers used to generate these bindings, which may differ from the loaded library.

CUFFT_DEVICE_VER_MAJOR.doc: Major component of the cuFFT experimental device API version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_DEVICE_VER_MINOR.doc: Minor component of the cuFFT experimental device API version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_DEVICE_VER_PATCH.doc: Patch component of the cuFFT experimental device API version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_VERSION.doc: Compile-time cuFFT version code. This identifies the headers used to generate these bindings, which may differ from the loaded library.

CUFFT_VER_BUILD.doc: Build component of the cuFFT version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_VER_MAJOR.doc: Major component of the cuFFT version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_VER_MINOR.doc: Minor component of the cuFFT version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_VER_PATCH.doc: Patch component of the cuFFT version used to generate these bindings.

CUFFT_WORKAREA_PERFORMANCE.doc: default - 1x overhead or more, maximum performance

CUFFT_XT_FORMAT_1D_INPUT_SHUFFLED.doc: shuffled input order prior to execution of 1D transforms

CUFFT_XT_FORMAT_INPLACE.doc: by default inplace is input order, which is linear across GPUs

CUFFT_XT_FORMAT_INPLACE_SHUFFLED.doc: shuffled output order after execution of the transform

CUFFT_XT_FORMAT_INPUT.doc: by default input is in linear order across GPUs

CUFFT_XT_FORMAT_OUTPUT.doc: by default output is in scrambled order depending on transform

cufftCompatibility.doc: CUFFT supports the following data layouts

cufftCompatibility_t.doc: CUFFT supports the following data layouts

cufftComplex.doc: cufftComplex is a single-precision, floating-point complex data type that consists of interleaved real and imaginary components. cufftDoubleComplex is the double-precision equivalent.

cufftHandle.doc: cufftHandle is a handle type used to store and access CUFFT plans.

cufftJITCallbackLoadC.doc: LTO callbacks (notice the different offset type vs. legacy callbacks)

cufftProperty.doc: Set/Get PlanProperty APIs configures per-plan behavior

cufftProperty_t.doc: Set/Get PlanProperty APIs configures per-plan behavior

cufftReal.doc: cufftReal is a single-precision, floating-point real data type. cufftDoubleReal is a double-precision, real data type.

cufftType.doc: CUFFT supports the following transform types

cufftType_t.doc: CUFFT supports the following transform types

cufftXtCopyType.doc: cufftXtCopyType specifies the type of copy for cufftXtMemcpy

cufftXtCopyType_t.doc: cufftXtCopyType specifies the type of copy for cufftXtMemcpy

cufftXtQueryType.doc: cufftXtQueryType specifies the type of query for cufftXtQueryPlan

cufftXtQueryType_t.doc: cufftXtQueryType specifies the type of query for cufftXtQueryPlan

cufftXtSubFormat.doc: cufftXtSubFormat identifies the data layout of a memory descriptor owned by cufft. note that multi GPU cufft does not yet support out-of-place transforms

cufftXtSubFormat_t.doc: cufftXtSubFormat identifies the data layout of a memory descriptor owned by cufft. note that multi GPU cufft does not yet support out-of-place transforms
